The vehicle is equipped with essential features like a backup camera, Bluetooth connectivity, collision warning, fog lights, heated seats, navigation system, premium audio, satellite radio readiness, and xenon headlights, ensuring convenience and safety on every trip. Additionally, a front license plate bracket has been installed, adding to its readiness for road use. Entertainment and technology are at the forefront in this Cascada. It features a 7-inch touch screen infotainment system with a voice-operated radio, ensuring easy access to music and navigation. The vehicle is Wi-Fi hotspot compatible and includes internet radio apps like Pandora and Stitcher, offering diverse entertainment options. It boasts seven speakers, an in-dash DVD audio system, and auxiliary inputs for USB and iPod/iPhone devices, providing versatile audio connectivity. Whether on long trips or daily commutes, this convertible keeps everyone entertained and connected. Performance is enhanced by a tuned sport suspension that delivers agile handling and a dynamic driving experience. This setup ensures that the Cascada handles confidently through curves while maintaining comfort over various road surfaces. The combination of a turbocharged engine and sport-tuned suspension makes this vehicle a compelling choice for those who want a stylish convertible that delivers engaging performance in every drive.

description: Experience the thrill of driving a 2020 Ford Mustang GT Premium Convertible, a perfect blend of power and style. With just over 67,000 miles, this used model boasts a striking blue exterior that commands attention. Under the hood, it features a 5.0-liter V8 engine delivering up to 460 horsepower and 420 lb-ft of torque, ensuring exhilarating performance on every drive. The rear-wheel-drive setup and naturally aspirated design make for an authentic muscle car experience. Inside, this Mustang offers a driver-focused cockpit with comfort features like heated and cooled seats, keyless entry, push-to-start ignition, and a spacious cabin for four. Modern connectivity is at your fingertips with Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, satellite radio readiness, and a Wi-Fi hotspot, while an 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system and nine speakers deliver crisp sound quality. This Mustang GT Premium Convertible is equipped with advanced safety and security features to provide peace of mind. Dual front knee airbags offer added protection, complemented by rear parking sensors that assist with parking precision. Four-wheel ABS enhances stopping power in emergency situations, while interior motion sensors and anti-tow systems deter theft. Power door locks include auto-locking and anti-lockout functions, and a programmable safety key allows for personalized access, making this vehicle as secure as it is exciting. 2020 Ford Mustang Safety and Security Features This model includes crucial safety components such as dual front knee airbags and rear parking sensors, which assist with parking and collision avoidance. Four-wheel ABS ensures reliable braking performance, and anti-theft measures like interior motion sensors and anti-tow sensors help protect your investment. Power door locks feature auto-locking and anti-lockout functions, while a programmable safety key provides added security, making the Mustang both safe and user-friendly. 2020 Ford Mustang Entertainment and Technology Features The Mustang’s infotainment system centers around an 8-inch touchscreen with voice-activated radio and hands-free phone call integration. FordPass Connect enables compatibility with smart device apps for remote engine start and cabin preconditioning, while nine speakers deliver immersive sound. Connected in-car apps through the app marketplace enhance convenience, and auxiliary USB inputs keep your devices charged and ready. The system also offers electronic messaging assistance with a read function, ensuring you stay connected safely. 2020 Ford Mustang Performance Features A key performance feature of this Mustang is the rear limited-slip differential, which enhances traction and handling during spirited drives and challenging road conditions. This component ensures optimal power distribution to the rear wheels, delivering better stability and control, especially when pushing the limits of the vehicle’s muscular 5.0-liter V8 engine.

The 2015 Jaguar F-TYPE S Convertible is one of the most visually dramatic and emotionally engaging sports cars of its era. Even more than a decade after its introduction, the F-TYPE remains one of the most desirable modern Jaguars ever produced, and this low-mileage S model is ready to reward every drive. Unlike many modern performance cars that prioritize outright speed above all else, the F-TYPE was engineered to create an emotional connection between driver and machine. Its combination of supercharged power, rear-wheel-drive dynamics, razor-sharp styling, and one of the most memorable exhaust notes in the industry helped it stand apart from rivals such as the Porsche Boxster, Chevrolet Corvette, and BMW Z4. It remains one of the purest expressions of Jaguar's sporting character. The critics were supposed to analyze the numbers ... but many ended up falling in love with the experience. The F-TYPE earned widespread praise for its styling, handling, soundtrack, and ability to make every drive feel special. Named to numerous annual performance-car and sports-car recommendation lists during its production run. Praised extensively for its stunning exterior design and unmistakable road presence. Configurable Dynamic Mode -- Allows customized vehicle-performance settings. Red Brake Calipers -- Distinctive high-performance appearance. Flat-Bottomed Steering Wheel -- Inspired by motorsport design. Metallic Pedals -- Adds a purposeful performance feel. Switchable Active Exhaust -- Allows the driver to unleash the F-TYPE's signature soundtrack. Super Performance Brakes -- Increased stopping capability and confidence. Interior Black Pack -- Sportier interior appearance. 14-Way Performance Seats -- Additional support during enthusiastic driving. HD Radio & SiriusXM Capability Expanded audio and entertainment options (may require subscription). 20'' Turbine Alloy Wheels Larger factory wheels that enhance both appearance and handling response. Red Seat Belts Distinctive performance-inspired interior accent. The F-TYPE S came from the factory loaded with performance and luxury features. Standard equipment includes a power-retractable soft top, leather upholstery, premium interior materials, keyless entry and ignition, navigation, Bluetooth connectivity, performance-oriented suspension tuning, sport seats, and a driver-focused cockpit designed to place every major control within easy reach. It successfully blends grand-touring comfort with genuine sports-car capability. At the heart of the F-TYPE S lies a supercharged 3.0-liter V6 producing an impressive 380 horsepower and 339 lb-ft of torque. Immediate throttle response, effortless passing power, and the unmistakable character of a supercharged engine make every drive memorable. The quick-shifting eight-speed automatic transmission delivers both smooth cruising and aggressive performance when called upon, helping the F-TYPE accelerate with authority while remaining surprisingly civilized during everyday driving. The Performance Pack further sharpens the experience with Configurable Dynamic Mode, allowing drivers to tailor throttle response, transmission behavior, and other vehicle dynamics to their preferences. Super Performance Brakes provide excellent stopping power, while the sport-tuned chassis delivers the balance, precision, and confidence expected from a world-class Jaguar sports car. Combined with the switchable active exhaust system, this F-TYPE offers an experience that engages all of the senses. Few modern sports cars possess the visual drama of the F-TYPE Convertible. Long hood proportions, muscular rear haunches, short overhangs, and an aggressively sculpted body create unmistakable road presence. The factory 20'' Turbine alloy wheels fill the wheel arches beautifully, while adaptive lighting technology improves visibility during nighttime driving. With the top lowered, the F-TYPE's design becomes even more striking, allowing occupants to enjoy both the scenery and the unforgettable soundtrack from the active exhaust system. The red leather interior transforms the cabin into something truly special. Rich materials, performance-inspired seating, red seat belts, black trim accents, and extensive power-seat adjustability create an environment that feels both luxurious and purposeful. 2003 Mazda MX-5 Miata LS | 6-Speed Manual | Torsen LSD | 80k Miles | Clean CARFAX

Some cars are simply fun to drive. Others become legends. The Mazda MX-5 Miata has managed to do both for more than three decades, and clean, unmodified NB examples continue to become harder to find each year.

Finished in Classic Red over black leather, this 2003 Mazda MX-5 Miata LS has traveled just 80,964 original miles and is equipped exactly the way enthusiasts want one. Power comes from Mazda's legendary 1.8-liter DOHC four-cylinder paired with the highly desirable 6-speed manual transmission and factory Torsen limited-slip differential, delivering one of the purest driving experiences available at any price.

This Miata is also equipped with the sought-after Factory Appearance Package, giving it a more aggressive look with factory front and rear spoilers, side skirts, and polished alloy wheels. Inside you'll find black leather seating, white-face gauges, the factory Bose premium audio system, power windows and locks, air conditioning, and an interior that has been exceptionally well preserved for its age.

According to the CARFAX, this Miata has no accidents or damage reported, spent nearly its entire life in Florida, and benefited from long-term ownership, including one owner who kept the car for over thirteen years. The CARFAX also documents a clutch replacement at approximately 67,000 miles, along with additional documented maintenance throughout its life.

Since arriving at PGA Automotive, we've invested in preparing this Miata for its next owner with mechanical servicing and cosmetic reconditioning. It starts easily, shifts smoothly through all six gears, drives exactly as a lightweight rear-wheel-drive roadster should, and is every bit as enjoyable whether you're carving through back roads or simply taking the scenic route home with the top down.

The NB Miata has become one of the most desirable generations of the MX-5, combining timeless styling with modern reliability and a driving experience that newer sports cars often struggle to replicate. Finding one with low mileage, a clean history, factory enthusiast options, and tasteful presentation is becoming increasingly uncommon.

If you've been waiting for the right Miata, this one deserves your attention.

Recent Service & Reconditioning

Before being offered for sale, this Miata received:

  • Valve cover gasket replacement

  • End camshaft seal replacement

  • Front brake pads

  • Rear brake pads

  • New shifter brass bushing

  • New clutch pedal stopper

  • Interior door handle replacement

  • Professional paint correction and full detail

Highlights

  • 1.8L DOHC 16-valve inline-four

  • 6-speed manual transmission

  • Factory Torsen limited-slip differential

  • LS trim

  • Clean Florida title
